Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future facility individual PNG artwork.
Primary request: ONE Seoul Hero facility illustration. Strict FRONT CUTAWAY view of a 2:1 wide room. The room contains three narrow cyan observation screens, a plum resonance chair and ivory sensor arms. Structural stage 1: one compact bench against the rear wall, low open shelves on one side, exposed rear pipes, a large open staff walking strip across the front. The front 20 percent is an unobstructed continuous staff walking strip, all machines and furniture stand behind it; no front walls, pillars or floating text obscure this area. Match the chunky SD urban-fantasy environment language: bold clean outlines, simple painted materials, pale ivory and navy structure with restrained teal/purple/orange indicators. No characters, baked labels, logos, UI frames, buttons or floor shadows on equipment. Clearly separate major silhouettes and retain generous safe margins. A complete fixed-view room/environment illustration; rear-wall depth only, no top-down/isometric alternative view.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
Modern Seoul guild facility artwork. For rooms use orthographic FRONTAL SIDE CUTAWAY, approximately 2:1, consistent horizontal floor height, clear foreground floor for separately overlaid SD employees. No people, HUD, text, buttons or isometric room view. Equipment is a separate transparent cutout, exterior and state follow the supplied subject.
Composition: single subject fully inside canvas, centered with 8 percent safe padding. No contact sheet or multiple examples.
Background: complete illustrated environment filling the image.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.
